outcome: NOT COMPLETED: the camera went silent 32-36 s after the point of no return; no installer event after ponr; no network path is left, recovery needs the SPI programmer

root_cause.conclusion: hardware watchdog reset in the middle of the post-PONR writes: quiesce all SIGSTOPped cmsMain.out, the only watchdog feeder
evidence: vendor U-Boot 2010.06 has wdstart/wdstop commands and the SP805-type watchdog constants (base 0x20040000, lock key 0x1ACCE551): it arms the watchdog before Linux starts
the stock system has no /dev/watchdog (diagnose action); stock cmsMain.out opens /dev/mem and contains the watchdog base (7x) and lock key (3x): it feeds the watchdog from user space
stock /usr/bin/wdstop (not stripped): main -> cmsdlWdInit (mmap /dev/mem at 0x20040000) -> cmsdlWdStop: [0xC00]=0x1ACCE551, [0x008]=0 (WdogControl off), [0xC00]=0
an earlier trial kernel without wdt.ko was reset about 1 min after boot; trial 5 with wdt.ko survived (watchdog armed by U-Boot)

quiesce all ran right after action start (about 17:17:28); the beacons stopped about 44 s later while the plan still needed about 60 s after PONR (trial write rate about 120 KiB/s: 40 blocks in 21 s) plus the sweep
the stock AP is in-kernel and stays up until the reboot, yet neither final-verified/final-degraded nor rebooting-final arrived although the host server listened for 9 more minutes
root_cause.resulting_boot: U-Boot bootm at 0x80007fc0 finds no image and stays in U-Boot until its own armed watchdog resets it: a silent reset loop. U-Boot offers only serial, USB and TFTP (no UART or Ethernet on this unit), so the network cannot recover it.

recovery.method: SPI programmer (8 MiB NOR), write a full image and verify by read-back
recovery.stock_option: the original full dump: U-Boot SHA-256 equals the pin checked on the live unit, mdat1/mdat2 are byte-identical to the backups exported just before PONR, vendor env has the same keys and values as the live env (only the key order differs after the trial saveenv)
recovery.openipc_option: compose_spi_image.py openipc: dump U-Boot + env-final.img + env-openipc.img + firmware.bin + erased rootfs_data; byte-identical to a replay of the installer write plan; the env-final boot path itself was never run on hardware
recovery.private_artifacts: outside Git (images carry the unit MAC and Wi-Fi keys)

required_before_another_network_final: after quiesce all, disable the watchdog with the stock sequence (unlock 0x1ACCE551 at +0xC00, WdogControl +0x008 = 0, relock) from the RAM runtime, read WdogControl back, and refuse to write if it is not 0
or keep feeding it from the RAM runtime (WdogIntClr) in a loop that quiesce never stops
new read-only hardware gate before any final: quiesce all + watchdog off, hold at least 120 s, resume, report
emit a best-effort progress event after every region after PONR, so a failure point is visible
host: stop NetworkManager from auto-joining the home uplink while the final runs
